critical_code_review_comments: share.js wrapText: when a single word exceeds maxWidth on the first line, lines.push(remaining) is reached via words.indexOf(w) which returns the FIRST occurrence — if the same token appears earlier in the text, slicing will repeat tokens. Edge case, low priority but worth a fix (track index in loop instead of indexOf).

ShareButton always resets to 'idle' after 3.5s regardless of state via a setTimeout that is set even when result === 'cancelled' (which already setState('idle')) — harmless but redundant. Consider clearing prior timeout on rapid re-clicks to avoid stacked timers.

shareResult uses navigator.canShare({files}) then a fallback navigator.share without files; on iOS Safari the second branch can leak text-only share even when file share was intended — current flow is acceptable but document the behaviour.
Static recipe PNGs are 540KB–740KB each; consider serving WebP or compressing to reduce mobile data — not blocking, just an optimization.
